<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_FindJob" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JobApplication" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ReceiptConfirmation" name="Application receipt confirmed and rated"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_InterviewNegotiated" name="Interview negotiated"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_NewJobOffer" name="New potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_WorkRequest" name="Company wants you to work for them"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CompanyRatesApplicant" name="Company rating of applicant"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ApplicantRatesCompany" name="Applicant rating of company"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job Applicant" processRef="Process_JobApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Application" name="Job application" messageRef="Msg_JobApplication" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="Participant_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Confirmation" name="Receipt confirmation and rating" messageRef="Msg_ReceiptConfirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Catch_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_InterviewNegotiated" name="Interview negotiated" messageRef="Msg_InterviewNegotiated" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Catch_InterviewNegotiated"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_NewOffer" name="New potential job offer" messageRef="Msg_NewJobOffer" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Catch_NewOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_WorkRequest" name="Work request" messageRef="Msg_WorkRequest" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Catch_WorkRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CompanyRatesApplicant" name="Company rating of applicant" messageRef="Msg_CompanyRatesApplicant" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Catch_CompanyRatingReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ApplicantRatesCompany" name="Applicant rating of company" messageRef="Msg_ApplicantRatesCompany" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Participant_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OffersContinue" name="Job offers without reporting" messageRef="Msg_NewJobOffer" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_JobApplicant" name="Find a Job" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_JobSearch" name="Job search started"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WriteApplication" name="Write job application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApplication" name="Send job application"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Confirmation" name="Application receipt confirmed and rated">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Confirmation" messageRef="Msg_ReceiptConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeReport" name="Reporting due"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_Outcome" name="Next outcome"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_InterviewNegotiated" name="Interview negotiated">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_InterviewNegotiated" messageRef="Msg_InterviewNegotiated"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AttendInterview" name="Attend job interview"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_NewOffer" name="New potential job offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_NewOffer" messageRef="Msg_NewJobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_WorkRequest" name="Company wants you to work for them">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_WorkRequest" messageRef="Msg_WorkRequest"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Probation" name="Enter and complete probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RateSplit" name="Rating and review split"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CompanyRatingReceived" name="Company rating of you received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CompanyRating" messageRef="Msg_CompanyRatesApplicant"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_OneYear" name="One year after rating">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ViewReviews" name="View company reviews"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReviewsVisible" name="Company reviews visible to applicants"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobPermanent" name="Job permanent and rating decision" default="Flow_ProcessEnds"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ProcessEnds" name="Process ends"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OffersMerge" name="Job offers continue"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive new job offers (no reporting)"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToWrite" sourceRef="Start_JobSearch" targetRef="Task_WriteApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WriteToSend" sourceRef="Task_WriteApplication" targetRef="Task_SendApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendToConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="Catch_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationToMerge" sourceRef="Catch_Confirmation" targetRef="Gateway_MergeReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToReport" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeReport" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportToOutcome" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Gateway_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutcomeToInterview" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="Catch_InterviewNegotiated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutcomeToNewOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="Catch_NewOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutcomeToWorkRequest" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="Catch_WorkRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewToAttend" sourceRef="Catch_InterviewNegotiated" targetRef="Task_AttendInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AttendToMerge" sourceRef="Task_AttendInterview" targetRef="Gateway_MergeReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NewOfferToMerge" sourceRef="Catch_NewOffer" targetRef="Gateway_MergeReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WorkRequestToProbation" sourceRef="Catch_WorkRequest" targetRef="Task_Probation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProbationToRate" sourceRef="Task_Probation" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateToSplit" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_RateSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToCompanyRating" sourceRef="Gateway_RateSplit" targetRef="Catch_CompanyRatingReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToTimer" sourceRef="Gateway_RateSplit" targetRef="Timer_OneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerToViewReviews" sourceRef="Timer_OneYear" targetRef="Task_ViewReviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ViewReviewsToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ViewReviews" targetRef="End_ReviewsVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingToPermanent" sourceRef="Catch_CompanyRatingReceived" targetRef="Gateway_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContinueOffers" name="Rating is C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_OffersMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${ratingAtMostC}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcessEnds" name="Job permanent, rating above C" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="End_ProcessEnds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OffersMergeToReceive" sourceRef="Gateway_OffersMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToOffersMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Gateway_OffersMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
